text.intro: Type up to 32 bytes in hex, separated by spaces or commas. The table shows the checksum sum growing one byte at a time. The bytes are toy bytes typed here, not anything read from a save, and the first ones offered are illustrative.
text.skipNote: The four bytes at offsets 12 to 15 are the checksum field of a save and count as 0, whatever is typed there.
text.errBad: A token is not one or two hex digits:
text.errLong: More than 32 bytes were typed; the table shows none.
text.note: Computed by our model of the rule, not observed in the game.
